content: OpenAI's official data controls state API content is not used to train models by default, but abuse-monitoring logs may retain content up to 30 days and endpoint features may persist application state; regional storage/processing applies only to eligible features/models and may require approval. Provider rate limits are organization/project/model-scoped rather than end-user-scoped, so Jobot must enforce per-user quotas and handle 429/Retry-After independently.
